title: DEMREVID003 - Script live-data comparison

cells.title: 00 · Prepare controlled test data
cells.explanation: Use authorized member IDs and synthetic amounts. Verify the scenario and suppression flag. Both implementations receive identical complete native tables.
cells.source:
" Read live facts with a separate secured adapter before entering fixture mode.
" Only backend-frozen base IDs are used; TIME is not expanded here.
DATA(periods) = io->range( 'TIME' ).
DATA(references) = io->range( 'REFERENCE_TIME' ).
APPEND LINES OF references TO periods.
SORT periods. DELETE ADJACENT DUPLICATES FROM periods.
DATA(filters) = VALUE zcl_bn_bpc=>tt_filters(
 ( dimension = 'CATEGORY' members = VALUE #( ( CONV string( io->member( 'CATEGORY' ) ) ) ) )
 ( dimension = 'TIME' members = CORRESPONDING #( periods ) ) ).
DATA(adapter) = NEW zcl_bn_bpc( environment = CONV string( io->environment )
 model = CONV string( io->model ) ).
DATA(source) = adapter->read_data( filters = filters max_rows = CONV i( io->input( 'READ_LIMIT' ) ) ).
FIELD-SYMBOLS <source> TYPE STANDARD TABLE. ASSIGN source->* TO <source>.
IF <source> IS INITIAL. RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE zcx_bn EXPORTING code = 'EMPTY_COMPARISON' detail = 'Live input is empty'. ENDIF.
io->enable_fixtures( VALUE #( ( environment = io->environment model = io->model rows = source ) ) ).
io->publish_dataset( name = 'FIXTURE_INPUT' rows = <source> ).
io->message( |Complete authorized live input retained: { lines( <source> ) } records| ).

cells.title: 01 · Load revenues and allocation drivers
cells.explanation:
Read authorized inputs and existing outputs for the selected category/output periods. Include explicitly selected mapping/lookback periods for reference reads. Separate revenue, geography, supplier and material mappings into complete working tables.

Check: Confirm the read diagnostics, period scope, source row counts and amounts. Empty inputs do not establish calculation equivalence.

DEFINE bn_field.
UNASSIGN &1.
ASSIGN COMPONENT &2 OF STRUCTURE &3 TO &1.
IF sy-subrc <> 0.
RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE zcx_bn EXPORTING code = 'BPC_SCRIPT_FIELD' detail = |Missing field: { &2 }|.
ENDIF.
END-OF-DEFINITION.
DEFINE bn_field_new.
FIELD-SYMBOLS &1 TYPE any.
bn_field &1 &2 &3.
END-OF-DEFINITION.
DEFINE bn_table.
FIELD-SYMBOLS &1 TYPE STANDARD TABLE.
ASSIGN &2->* TO &1.
END-OF-DEFINITION.
DEFINE bn_row.
DATA &1 TYPE REF TO data.
CREATE DATA &1 LIKE LINE OF &2.
FIELD-SYMBOLS &3 TYPE any.
ASSIGN &1->* TO &3.
END-OF-DEFINITION.

cells.explanation:
Apply product-type overwrite, product revenue group, account connection-region mapping, L1/L2 mapping, material remap, material group and regulatory service. Material-group revenue group overrides product-type revenue group only when populated. Preserve the exact original lookup order.

Check: Trace a material/account with both specific and default mappings. Verify the winning mapping and any unchanged default.

cells.title: 16 · Reallocate HSNS premium revenue
cells.explanation:
Credit the original HSNS allocation, rebuild from uploaded billing, map bandwidth to the associated access/rental group, and split accrual using material-level billing ratios before material-group fallback. Apply configured supplier exclusions at the original stage.

Check: Reconcile credits/replacement revenue. Verify a material with only ID-only billing does not acquire PQ through a blended group fallback.

cells.title: 17 · Calculate material FFLAS ratios and skipped flags
cells.explanation:
Build SAP revenue denominators; create DEMREVID052 flags for suppressed material groups before excluding them. Divide allocated FFLAS revenue by the remaining base, assign residual to non-FFLAS, and add rounding discrepancy to the same existing row selected by the original ordering.

Check: Ratios reconcile to one for nonzero eligible bases. Suppressed combinations have flags rather than ratios. Test rounding, negative bases, zero bases and both suppression settings.
